goodToKnow: Das Sodbrennen is heartburn, caused by stomach acid (Magensäure) rising into the oesophagus (Speiseröhre). Sod is an old word related to sieden (to simmer, boil), describing the burning rise. Typical triggers include fatty food, coffee and alcohol. The medical term for chronic reflux is die Refluxkrankheit. It has no plural.
